test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.**

The captain said, “What are we doing on the pitch if we are not playing?”

options.text: The captain asked what are we doing on the pitch if we are not playing.
The captain wanted to know what were they doing on the pitch if they are not playing.
The captain asks what they are doing on the pitch if they are not playing.
The captain asked what they were doing on the pitch if they were not playing.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The captain asked what they were doing on the pitch if they were not playing. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is a direct speech and we need to convert it into an indirect speech.
 
• We follow these rules in Direct-Indirect speech:
 
 
• The reporting verb 'said' changes to 'asked' as the question tag is present in the direct speech.
 
• The **'question tag'** in direct speech changes to a **'full stop'** in indirect speech.
 
• The pronoun '**we**' in direct speech changes to '**they**' in indirect speech.
 
• The **present continuous** tense becomes **past continuous** in indirect speech therefore, '**are**' changes to '**were**'.
 
• The inverted commas ("...") are omitted to show the indirect speech part.
 
• The comma (,) is omitted to show the indirect speech part.
 
• The first word of the indirect speech is in capital letters.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

The indirect sentence is: *The captain asked what they were doing on the pitch if they were not playing. *
